live.title: Live desk
live.subtitle: The customer on the left, the operator on the right. Both sides are live.

open.body: Pick a delivery topic, then start the chat. Ana's details are pre-filled.

ask.body: Try: "What goes with khachapuri?" The bot answers with sources.

human.body: Press the button. The chat jumps into the queue with a briefing.

claim.body: Open the new chat in the queue and claim it.

reply.title: Reply with help
reply.body: Use the Copilot draft or a quick reply and send it.

rate.title: End and rate
rate.body: Finish the chat, then rate it as the customer.

delivery.title: Delivery and gifts

gifts.title: Gift boxes
